en-US.description: Open multiple files, folders, and URLs instantly with Vovsoft Open Multiple Files. Save clicks, automate startup, and create batch files easily.
en-US.longDescription:
Working with multiple files, folders, executables or URLs at the same time can result in hectic situations, especially when trying to launch or open several instances at a time. Carried out manually, this process can be at least tiresome, not to mention inefficient. Vovsoft Open Multiple Files is an instant file opener that helps users cope with such issues and allow them to open multiple files or folders simultaneously. You can save thousands of clicks and make your life easier with the help of this little software.

Adding files or folders is a breeze and users can do so by either resorting to the dedicated menu, buttons or by dragging-and-dropping. Once files or folders have been added, these will appear listed in the app's main viewing area for better identification. After that, all you have to do is click the "Open Multiple Files" button.

This multi-file opener tool will quickly launch all the added content, simultaneously, in the inserted order. The program will automatically open all the entries you add to the list, in the same order. You no longer have to deal with one by one when you need to open multiple files. Add the files you need, the software will open all files for you.

Additionally, the installer can add shortcut to SendTo folder, so that users can right-click files & folders from the context menu and run them all at once.

Besides files and folders, the app can also receive links (URLs) as input, as well as executable files, and provides users a broader usage palette. Users can open multiple links by adding URLs to the list.

If you need to open multiple files, folders or URLs at Windows start-up, you can easily do this by using this software. You only need to add the items to the list, then use the Settings menu and enable the "Remember List", "Auto Open List" and "Auto Run at Startup" menu items. Optionally, you can also enable the "Auto Close Application" menu item in order to close the application itself after the job is done.

A great feature of Vovsoft Open Multiple Files is the ability to save the added content as a text listing or a batch file for later use. This not only improves overall efficiency but also offers people the ability to manage their multi-file sessions better.
